scope: Local owner and operator product routes served read-only from scripts/app; no VowVault deployment, transaction or payment

accessibility.method: Static assertions over the shipped HTML and CSS in packages/vow-sdk/test/app-screens.test.ts

confirmed: The absent deployment manifest is reported on both screens and every write control is disabled
The skip link receives a visible 3px focus outline on keyboard focus
notConfirmed: No end-to-end owner or operator flow was exercised in a real browser, because binding a mandate id requires a deployed VowVault and none exists
No wallet was connected, no signature requested and no transaction submitted

limitations: No dist/deployment/manifest.json is shipped; both screens load fail-closed and neither has produced a transaction.

The owner screen predicts the next mandate id by scanning public mandate reads. A concurrent create_mandate takes that id, and a permission set committed to the wrong mandate id can never be reserved against. The screen states this before creation; the contract exposes no next-mandate view that would remove the race.

Reservation reconciliation checks an accepted, non-reverted receipt in a block that still contains the transaction and a vault-emitted event of the expected name. It does not verify the full internal call path.
Page behaviour is asserted against a synthetic DOM and a synthetic RPC, not a live network.
Contrast is computed from the shipped CSS tokens; no assistive-technology or screen-reader pass was performed.
